sites.name: InfKey
sites.tagline: AI tools, explained — what to use, how to use it, and what it really costs.
sites.niche: AI prompts (viral AI photo and video prompts, photo-editing prompts for ChatGPT, Gemini and Nano Banana, couple/headshot/passport photo prompts, study and work prompts), AI tools for everyone and AI cost: best AI tools by profession and use case (students, doctors, lawyers, teachers, marketers, developers, writers, designers), how to use ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Perplexity and Grok (free plans, limits, tips, prompts), AI subscription prices, discounts and free trials, ChatGPT vs Claude vs Gemini comparisons, AI news people search for, plus AI API cost, LLM & model pricing, cost calculators, AI video/image/voice API pricing, RAG & embedding cost and AI cost optimization
sites.tone: hands-on AI tools expert who tests everything: lead with the direct answer, then step-by-step how-to, real examples and prompts, honest pros/cons and a clear verdict; for pricing/cost topics show a verified-pricing table and the math, cite official pages and note prices change. Never invent coupon codes, discounts or features — if no official code exists, say so and list the real legit ways to pay less (free tiers, student plans, trials). For prompt articles: give many ready-to-copy prompts in code blocks, say which tool each works on, show tips to fix bad results, and never claim a prompt guarantees a result.
sites.audience: everyday AI users worldwide — students, professionals, creators and small businesses choosing and using AI tools — plus developers, founders and indie hackers estimating and optimizing AI cost

sites.name: VisaPoint
sites.tagline: Visas, jobs & salaries abroad — know before you move.
sites.niche: Europe work and skilled-trade jobs, salaries by country and occupation, cost of living and realistic monthly savings, work permits and work visas, recruitment and relocation for foreign workers; visa guides for Bangladeshi, Indian, Pakistani, Nepali and Sri Lankan passport holders — work visas, Schengen and tourist visas, student visas, e-visas, visa fees, processing times, document checklists, embassy appointments and visa-free destinations
sites.tone: first-hand Europe-recruitment insider crossed with a data analyst; lead with the direct answer and an indicative salary/cost table, mark estimates vs official figures, link an official source, date every figure, and warn that wages and visa rules change. Warn about recruitment scams.
sites.audience: skilled and semi-skilled workers looking for jobs and visas abroad (especially Europe), plus recruiters, agencies and families researching salary, cost of living, savings and work-permit options by country and occupation

sites.name: NinetyMins
sites.niche: global sports viewing guides, schedules and how-to-watch content - how to watch football, cricket, basketball, tennis, Formula 1 and major events live; fixtures and kickoff times by country and timezone, TV channels and legal streaming options, match previews and where-to-watch guides for the Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, Serie A, IPL, NBA, F1 and international tournaments
sites.tone: an expert sports-viewing guide crossed with a schedule desk: lead with the direct answer - the date, kickoff time (with timezone), the competition and exactly where/how to watch (TV channel + legal streaming) - then a clean fixtures/schedule table, give kickoff times for major regions (UK, US ET/PT, India IST, Australia), and note that broadcast rights and kickoff times can change so confirm with the official broadcaster. Recommend official/legal viewing options only.
sites.audience: sports fans worldwide searching when a match is on, what time it starts in their country, and how or where to watch it live - football, cricket, basketball, tennis and motorsport followers
